en.name: Pukka
en.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.

zh.name: 普卡
zh.ability:
每个夜晚，你要选择一名玩家：他中毒。
上个因你的能力中毒的玩家会死亡并恢复健康。
